name: Instagram Live
strategic_objective: Real-time connection, Q&A, launches, and deepening trust through unedited interaction.

tone: Human, direct, and responsive. Less polished than feed content but still on-brand and intentional.
copywriting_rules: Title and description should clearly state the topic, who it is for, and what viewers will gain. Keep the description concise and outcome-focused. During the Live, repeat the key value proposition and CTA regularly for people who join late.
Title: clear and specific topic. Description: 2–3 short lines covering what, who, and why now. Include 1 main CTA (follow, visit profile, tap link).
Support context for joiners and highlight key moments.
Use pinned comments to restate topic and CTA
Use occasional on-screen text overlays for key points if using external tools
Keep any text short and immediately understandable
Focus on topic and series consistency. Do not overuse broad, generic tags.
Tag co-hosts, guests, or brands in the announcement and recap posts to amplify reach.

required_generation_elements: Single main CTA repeated throughout the session
Active interaction with chat (questions, shout-outs, answers)
Opening hook explaining what viewers will get from staying
hard_constraints: Starting the Live without explaining the topic
Clickbait titles that are not aligned with the actual content
